name: Finding Hidden Compartments
hint_layers: Treat the box as a physical object: rotate it and inspect every face.
Look for seams, buttons, sliders, and panels that can move.
Use keys only after matching the lock shape and position.
solution: Rotate the puzzle box, inspect each face, interact with movable mechanisms, and use matching keys to open hidden compartments.

name: Using the Eyepiece
hint_layers: If an engraving or symbol seems incomplete, the normal view may not be enough.
Equip the eyepiece and re-check suspicious surfaces.
Some secrets require changing your viewing angle until the symbol aligns.
solution: Equip the special lens to reveal Null-related hidden markings, then rotate or align the view until the hidden symbol becomes coherent.

name: Opening Nested Puzzle Boxes
hint_layers: The goal is usually not one lock; it is a chain of mechanisms.
Every solved lock tends to reveal a smaller or more complex mechanism.
When stuck, revisit old faces after new compartments open.
solution: Fully unlock the current box by solving its mechanism chain; each solved layer exposes a smaller or more complex box inside.
